description: Four inversions of the same kind in 2HP, the kind chosen by one switch

params.text: Chooses the inversion: !Gt turns a high gate into a low one and back, * -1 multiplies by -1, !Rng flips the value within the range set on the menu

inputs.text: One of the four signals to be inverted

outputs.text: Carries the input of the same letter inverted by the chosen rule

notes: with the switch at !Gt and the gate output levels swapped on the menu, the module turns any signal into a plain gate rather than inverting one
menu: Inversion-range — sets the range the !Rng position flips a value within, 0V to 10V unless you change it
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
Gate-high detect-level — sets the voltage at which an incoming gate counts as high, 1V or more unless you change it
Gate-high output-level — sets the voltage a gate output carries while high, 10V unless you change it
Gate-low output-level — sets the voltage a gate output carries while low, 0V unless you change it
